nodes.label: CB Soft+Bypass Gate Impasse
nodes.rationale: confluence_breakout has gate_mode:soft AND bypass_fusion_threshold:true — any hard_gate tightening is structurally a no-op while both coexist; hard mode blocks 78% of profitable trades. Needs a third gate-evaluation mode that does not exist.

nodes.label: long_squeeze Selection Asymmetry
nodes.rationale: Whenever long_squeeze trades are filtered by a regime signal the WINS get filtered, not the losses — winning trades are contrarian-correct inside bull regimes; regime gates are the wrong tool, the discriminator (if any) is bar-level.

nodes.label: oi_divergence Detection Suspect
nodes.rationale: oi_divergence loses regardless of direction (3 attempts); historical parquet lacks actual OI columns so the archetype fires on fallback gates (volume_zscore + RSI) it was never designed around — Binance OI backfill needed to test the real hypothesis.
